text:
harpreet: FYI - eu-west2 GPU health alert: aggregated ECC/Xid errors spiked ~4x starting 02:02 UTC, capacity showing -9% available GPUs.
margo: saw increased allocation failures around 02:05. Any recent infra change?
infra-bot: alert: region=eu-west2 metric=ECC_RATE alerted at 1724790100; current_rate=3.8x baseline; draining_count=16 gpus across 5 racks; autoscaler: paused_new_nodes=true
kai: we pushed BIOS+FW bundle b5.2 to a canary rack at 01:48 and promoted to racks 10-14 at 01:59. Could be related.
tomas: grabbing logs from rack-12 now. early signs: repeated 'pcie_uncorr_err' and NVMe reset, followed by Xid 62 then driver resets.
harpreet: paste of snippet:
``
[02:03:12] gpu-12-01: pcie_uncorr_err, link_state=down
[02:03:15] gpu-12-01: nvme: reset start
[02:03:17] gpu-12-01: Xid 62, wedge detected
[02:03:19] gpu-12-01: driver reset, queue drained
```
margo: that looks like a firmware-induced PCIe handling regression. Let's halt the rollout and rollback canary racks to b5.1.
kai: rollback cmd ready: `infractl rollback-bundle --bundle b5.1 --racks 10-14 --concurrency 3` - estimated 7-9 minutes per rack due to node reboots.
harpreet: note: rollback will cause ~56 GPUs offline transiently. If we take all at once we risk further perf hits.
finance-bot: cost alert: cross-region spill predicted to incur ~$4.2k additional hourly cost if we shift 2000 inference requests to on-demand in us-west.
tomas: propose: 1) pause rollout, 2) rollback racks with highest CE counts (12,13 first), 3) set autoscaler to not create new eu-west2 nodes, 4) tilt critical traffic to dedicated pool.
margo: +1. also enable short-term regional routing policy: `route.override.euwest2.wait_s>25 -> prefer=dedicated, fallback=us-west`
harpreet: starting rollback on rack-12 now. will report progress. initiating pause of autoscaling in eu-west2.
infra-bot: action: rollback rack-12 started at 1724790180; estimated done in 7m
tomas: rack-12 rollback complete at 02:12. ECC/Xid counts on those nodes dropped ~78% within 3 mins.
harpreet: rolling rack-13.
finance-bot: approved emergency use of up to 18 reserved GPUs from dedicated pool for 30m to keep p95 latency under 200ms.
kai: rack-13 rollback done at 02:20; overall eu-west2 ECC rate trending down but still above baseline. continuing broader health probes.
margo: next: run a targeted hardware validation job across racks 10-15 for 24h and hold firmware channel until triage finishes. Also open INFRA-5011 for hardware/vendor engagement.
harpreet: filing incident ticket INFRA-5009 with logs, rollbacks, and timeline. Will post incident summary in incidents channel after RCA.
infra-bot: note: autoscaler new_nodes blocked at 1724790210; drains initiated for 16 GPUs
harpreet: thanks all. keep repro steps and any failing device IDs pinned here. Closing slack thread; follow-ups in INFRA-5009.
